    • allowPreReleases

      @Parameter(property="allowPreReleases", defaultValue="false") protected boolean allowPreReleases
      Whether to offer pre-release versions: alpha, beta, milestone, release candidate, preview and early-access versions, such as 4.0.0-beta-4 or 3.34.0.CR1. When false, a pre-release is still offered if the current version is itself a pre-release or a snapshot of the same release line, so 4.0.0-beta-3 is offered 4.0.0-beta-4 but not 4.1.0-M1. Snapshots are governed by allowSnapshots, and ignoredVersions and rules still apply on top.
      Since:
      2.25.0 (2.20.0 for use-latest-versions)

    • ignoredVersions

      @Parameter(property="maven.version.ignore") protected Set<String> ignoredVersions

      Allows specifying ignored versions directly as an alternative to providing the ruleSet parameter; mainly created for -D property usage.

      Example: "1\.0\.1,.+-M.,.*-SNAPSHOT"

      Currently, this parameter will override the defined ruleSet

      Since:
      2.13.0

    • dependabotConfig

      @Parameter(property="versions.dependabotConfig") protected String dependabotConfig

      A Dependabot configuration file whose ignore entries are applied as version rules, on top of ruleSet, rulesUri and ignoredVersions.

      Only the package-ecosystem: maven entries for dependabotTargetBranch are read. Each versions item may be a Maven version range, a comparator requirement such as ">= 5.0.0", or a single version. Items that only use update-types are skipped with a warning. A relative path is resolved against the multi-module project directory.

      Example: -Dversions.dependabotConfig=.github/dependabot.yml

      Since:
      2.25.0

    • dependabotTargetBranch

      @Parameter(property="versions.dependabotTargetBranch") protected String dependabotTargetBranch

      The target-branch whose entries in dependabotConfig apply. Defaults to the branch checked out in the git working tree holding that file; the entries without a target-branch are used when no entry names the branch.

      Since:
      2.25.0

    • minimumReleaseAge

      @Parameter(property="versions.minimumReleaseAge", defaultValue="0") protected int minimumReleaseAge
      Minimum number of days a release must have been published before it is offered as an update. This keeps a very recent release, which may be faulty or compromised, out of the update candidates; Renovate calls the same idea minimumReleaseAge, and Dependabot calls it cooldown.
      A version older than or equal to the current one is not affected. The publication date is read through Maven's own transport, so the proxy, mirror and server settings apply. If the date cannot be determined, the version is offered and a warning says so. 0, the default, switches the filter off.
      Since:
      2.25.0

    • minimumReleaseAgeExcludes

      @Parameter(property="versions.minimumReleaseAgeExcludes") protected String[] minimumReleaseAgeExcludes
      groupId:artifactId patterns of the artifacts that are exempt from minimumReleaseAge, for artifacts whose sources you trust. * matches any run of characters, and an artifactId may be left out to match the whole group, for example com.example:* or com.example.
      On the command line, separate the patterns with commas.
      Since:
      2.25.0
